reason: I've never heard of REPAIHUB, and my NRO balance is under 5 lakh, so I'd be handing a stranger my savings to save a bit of hassle. I'd rather ask my family's CA in India for the 15CB, which costs me a few thousand rupees, and compare the bank's rate with Wise myself.
objection: I don't know these people. A FINTRAC number on their own site is not enough for me to trust a new startup with my money when I can't see who is behind it. Also the fee is on top of the partner bank's rate, and I can't tell how much margin is hidden in that rate.
would_change_my_mind: Reviews from people in my community groups who moved money with them and got it on time, plus a rate comparison showing the all-in cost against Wise and my own bank.
